scripts.build:orchestrator: npm run build -w @agent-studio/agent-schema && npm run build -w @agent-studio/orchestrator
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:orchestrator && npm run build:schema && npm run dev -w @agent-studio/studio-api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:orchestrator && npm run build:schema && npm run dev:worker -w @agent-studio/studio-api
scripts.dev:bridge: npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w @agent-studio/bridge && npm run start -w @agent-studio/studio-bridge
scripts.dev:bridge-desktop: npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w @agent-studio/bridge && npm run tauri:dev -w @agent-studio/bridge-desktop
scripts.build:bridge-desktop: npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w @agent-studio/bridge && npm run tauri:build -w @agent-studio/bridge-desktop
scripts.bridge: npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w @agent-studio/bridge && npm exec -w @agent-studio/bridge -- agent-studio-bridge
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-studio/agent-schema && npm run build -w @agent-studio/orchestrator && npm run build -w @agent-studio/agent-runtime && npm run build -w @agent-studio/bridge && npm run build -w @agent-studio/studio-api && npm run build -w @agent-studio/studio-web && npm run build -w @agent-studio/studio-bridge
scripts.test: npm test -w @agent-studio/agent-runtime && npm test -w @agent-studio/bridge && npm test -w @agent-studio/orchestrator && npm test -w @agent-studio/studio-api && npm test -w @agent-studio/studio-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agent-studio/bridge && npm run typecheck -w @agent-studio/orchestrator && npm run typecheck -w @agent-studio/studio-api
